title: Why the drummers kept changing
summary: Mickey Roker, Bobby Thomas and Pete LaRoca filled in when free; the group needed little from the drummer. Buddy was back on piano.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Why was it so difficult to settle on somebody?

One of the reasons being so is like, for example, we had a period where Mickey Roker played with us. But he only played because he was off during that period, and that pretty much was the case. Bobby Thomas worked with us, because he had that period away from school or whatever it was. Who else worked with...Pete LaRoca played with us. They were all great drummers.
